column1: # time_to_first_viable_diff_s: seconds from prompt send to first git diff that compiles
# time_to_tests_pass_s: seconds from prompt send to all tests green (empty if never passes)
# token_cost_usd: actual API cost in USD (Cursor Pro: $0.0033/min; API-key mode: actual token cost)
# human_escalations: integer count of times runner had to intervene
# tool_edit_cycles: integer count of distinct edit → save → observe cycles
# loc_changed: total lines added+deleted in final diff
# loc_minimum_needed: reviewer estimate of minimum LOC needed (enter manually post-run)
# notes: git hash, any anomalies, baseline_pass status
